partnerships.scope: Summit in-licensed exclusive ivonescimab development and commercialization rights in the United States, Canada, Europe, Japan, Latin America, the Middle East and Africa; Akeso conducts its own China-based studies.
The companies agreed to a nonexclusive clinical study of Summit-supplied ivonescimab with GSK’s B7-H3 antibody–drug conjugate risvutatug rezetecan; each retains rights to its own product.
GORTEC leads and sponsors the European portion of the Phase 3 ILLUMINE ivonescimab study in head-and-neck cancer; Akeso is the China sponsor and Summit is a collaborator.

Summit signed an agreement to sell the Phase 3 C. difficile asset ridinilazole to Biossil in exchange for an upfront payment, potential milestones and royalties; closure was not established by the announcement.
